summary: David Bass, 64, of Hutchinson, Kansas, drowned at Steamboat Lake after the boat he was fixing a trolling motor on drifted away from shore Friday afternoon; he swam after it and disappeared under the surface; his body was recovered just after midnight early Saturday.
notes: Kansas Public Radio AP item, 'Headlines for Monday, June 18, 2018', citing Steamboat Today; 'Friday afternoon' = 2018-06-15 (Friday-verified), body recovered just after midnight early Saturday June 16. Recovering agency not named in the AP item; Routt County Coroner Rob Ryg quoted. North Forty News Mutabazi article (July 15, 2018) corroborates: Mutabazi was 'the second drowning at Steamboat Lake State Park in the last two months.' Run 1020 chunk C; resolves the parked Kansas Steamboat Lake drowning lead (run 1002).
